verdicts.reason: A shrinks the FIZZBANG logo and soda can to near-illegible specks at the bottom, which guts the branding. Its CTA is centred under left-aligned copy, so it sits on neither axis, and the right and bottom third of the canvas is left empty. B keeps the logo and can at a readable size, aligned to the text column, and gives the controller proper weight. But it puts the CTA in the top-right corner above the headline, which breaks the reading order, and the button's right edge doesn't line up with the text column.
